title: Playboy Magazine July 1964 Summer Fun Issue Helen Gurley Brown Andre Maurois
conditionDescription: Cover bright with light edge and corner wear, light toning to the back. Spine intact. Centerfold not separately verified.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, July 1964 - Summer Fun Issue. Cover price 75 cents.

Features:
- How to Throw a Beach Bash
- How Not to Build a Pool
- "BB: The Sex Kitten Grows Up" by Andre Maurois
- Helen Gurley Brown on "Sex and the Office"
- Plus Saroyan and Dali

The lipstick-rabbit bikini cover. The back cover carries a 1964 Gordon's Gin "Gordon's & Tonic" ad.

Condition: Good for its age - cover bright and glossy with light edge and corner wear and light toning to the back cover; spine intact. Complete. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
